requirements: True corner composition: two slender botanical runs depart from one shared corner nexus at roughly a right angle
The inner contour must read as a concave framing corner, not as one sweeping crescent, feather or laurel arc
Keep the ornament visually restrained: target roughly 18–28% occupied area on a square source canvas
Preserve at least about 70% central negative space so content remains visually dominant
Use fine tapered stems with clear hierarchy from primary branch to secondary twigs and leaflets
Use smaller differentiated leaves with natural spacing, varied angles and restrained asymmetry
The silhouette must feel botanically grown from the corner instead of pasted onto the image area
Maintain an elegant visual weight compatible with refined serif typography and small medallion details
Avoid uniform thickness: stems and terminal elements should visibly taper toward their ends
Keep sufficient local negative space between leaves and branches to avoid one heavy contiguous blob
Transparent background with a clean isolated silhouette and no surrounding frame rectangle
Forms must remain contiguous and simple enough to trace cleanly into a reusable SVG mask
The silhouette must remain legible and graceful when reduced to approximately 160 px corner size
No baked material appearance; shape and material must remain separable for independent recoloring or texturing
High source resolution with clean anti-aliased edges and no accidental crop at the outer canvas edges
Visual review must compare against a strong existing Hall-of-Memory frame treatment, not a deliberately weak placeholder geometry
forbidden: No broad ribbon-like main arc spanning most of the image
No feather, fern-frond, clipart-laurel or stencil-like silhouette
No oversized repeated oval leaves or scalloped rhythm
No heavy solid mass that dominates the framed content area
No closed or near-closed semicircle around the content
No mechanically repeated leaf modules or regular spacing
No hard diamond-like, rectangular or mechanically rotated geometry
No shadows, glow, bevel, embossing or three-dimensional lighting
No gold, metallic, paper or other material texture in the source master
No text, lettering, logos or watermark
No complete four-corner frame in this source master
No assumption that mirroring or rotation preserves the intended natural composition
